name: For Season ~Meguriyuku Kisetsu no Naka de~
original_name: For Season ～めぐりゆく季節の中で～
source:
You are hired as a family tutor, and you pick three girls of your choice (from five) as your students. In six months time (July to January), you are to assist these three girls in getting into University.

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=225&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
你受雇担任家庭教师，并从五名少女中任选三人作为自己的学生。在六个月内，即从七月到次年一月，你要辅导这三名少女考入大学。

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=225&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
